Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_AmmoSupplyCase: Airdropped by the military. Open it to get ammunition.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_WeaponSupplyCase: Airdropped by the military. Open it to get a weapon.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_ArmorSupplyCase: Airdropped by the military. Open it to get military clothing and gear.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_AttachmentSupplyCas: Airdropped by the military. Open it to get weapon attachments.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_Codebook: Military code table. Deciphers the weekly code sent by the numbers station.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_DecoyBeacon: DIVERSION. This drop carries no supplies: its siren draws the dead toward the crate.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_RequisitionCase: Delivered by the military on your requisition. Open it to get the ordered supplies.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_FlightRecorder: Flight recorder recovered from a downed helicopter. Read it in the reader bay of a liaison station, then send its data to Logistics.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_FultonBalloonFolded: Sewn tarp envelope. Assemble it with a harness bag and wire.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_FultonHarnessBag: Cargo bag fitted with a rope harness. Assemble it with a folded balloon and wire.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_FultonKit: Single-use balloon recovery system. Inflating it takes one charge from a helium tank.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_FultonKitDamaged: Torn envelope and frayed harness. Can be repaired with thread, duct tape and wire.
Tooltip_MilitaryDrop_HeliumTank: Enough helium to inflate four Fulton balloons. The empty steel tank can be cut up with a blowtorch.
